recovery.name: TWRP
requirements: Step 1 writes TWRP 3.0.2 (2016, the last jfltexx build Odin takes as one image); step 2 replaces it from inside TWRP with the current 3.6.1 (unified jflte build).
Boot straight into TWRP after step 1: a normal boot can restore the stock recovery.
recovery.imported_from: https://dl.twrp.me/jfltexx/ and https://dl.twrp.me/jflte/ (sha256 checked against TeamWin's .sha256 files)

stages.title: Install TWRP 3.0.2
stages.optional: Skip if TWRP is already installed.
stages.warning: Replaces the recovery partition. Boot straight into TWRP afterwards: a normal boot can restore the stock recovery.
stages.done: TWRP written. Pull the battery, put it back, then hold Volume Up + Home + Power until TWRP appears.

stages.title: Update TWRP to 3.6.1 from inside TWRP
stages.optional: Skip if TWRP 3.6 or newer is already installed.
stages.warning: Overwrites the recovery partition while TWRP runs from memory. If the write fails, Download Mode still works: run step 1 again.
stages.done: TWRP 3.6.1 written and verified on the phone. In TWRP: Reboot › Recovery to start it (a plain reboot starts Android).
